t: You're at the Grade II listed statue of Lord Holland in Holland Park, on the northern walk out of the remains of Holland House. It shows Henry Vassall-Fox, the third Baron Holland, a Whig politician and nephew of Charles James Fox. He served as Lord Privy Seal and as Chancellor of the Duchy of Lancaster. The statue was made by two well-known artists: the sculptor Joseph Edgar Boehm, and the painter and sculptor George Frederic Watts, known for allegorical works such as Hope and Love and Life.
